title: Radial gradient visual oracle — focalPoint path verified in Ruffle
description:
The visual-oracle.spec.ts suite has a linear gradient render-consistency test (test 4) but no radial gradient counterpart. The gradient-debug.spec.ts is a diagnostic save-to-disk helper, not a pass/fail oracle. The core model and SWF encoder support radial gradients with a focalPoint field, but there is no runtime proof that the full path (model → DefineShape4 GRADRECORD with FocalGradient → Ruffle render) produces correct output.

Add a radial gradient visual oracle E2E test following the established pattern (inject Ruffle, compile, screenshot, pixelmatch):

  1. Build a FlashDocument with a 200×200 radial gradient rectangle (red center → blue edge, focalPoint=0.3).
  2. Compile via __flashTest.publish().
  3. Load in Ruffle, screenshot.
  4. Assert non-blank (diff vs white > threshold).
  5. Assert the center region is reddish and the edge region is bluish (channel-level pixel checks), proving the gradient direction is correct in the SWF and Ruffle renders it faithfully.
  6. Optionally compare against the Flash canvas renderer screenshot (mismatch < 20%) to catch regressions in both renderers.

Files: apps/desktop/e2e/visual-oracle.spec.ts (add test 4b) or a new apps/desktop/e2e/gradient-oracle.spec.ts.
